verdict.rationale: Smooth's docs say every session returns a live view URL for watching the agent browse in real time (smooth-docs-2, smooth-docs-29). They also explicitly state you can take over and interact with the browser yourself (smooth-docs-29). Together these cover both halves of the story. Missing for 10: details on how takeover works mid-run (pausing the agent, handing control back, resuming the task), anything beyond one-line doc mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that takeover works.
